items.title: Pay final electricity invoice
items.quote: Der Rechnungsbetrag ist innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug zur Zahlung fällig.
items.computation: Start: invoice date 14.04.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (invoice date) is not counted, so the 30-day period begins 15.04.2026. Counting 30 days from 14.04.2026 lands on 14.05.2026 (April 14 + 30 days = May 14, since this is a day-period, not a calendar month). 14.05.2026 is a Thursday, not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. This is a payment to a company, so the payer's own Land (NRW) holidays apply, and none affect this date.
